Company snapshot: small SaaS studio building automated content pipelines for SMB marketing teams. Editor + bulk export features; customers generate high-volume short form + blog drafts. Cost sensitivity high — primary metric is $/generated-word.

Technical profile / asks:

- Volume: initial estimate 100k–300k short generations/month; peak bursts during campaign sends.
- Token estimate: roughly 10–25M tokens/month at current usage pattern.

- Throughput: bulk generation jobs (daily/weekly) need high throughput but can tolerate longer wall time.
- Cost controls: strong interest in batching, prefix/KV caching for template reuse, and lower-cost model fallbacks for lower-priority jobs.
- Model preference: open/quantized models preferred (7B–13B families) to keep per-token cost down; interested in Redwood's curated performance profiles.
- Security: SMB-level — wants audit logging and simple API key lifecycle; SSO not required for now.

Calls / quotes: "We need cheaper per-output cost than current vendor — hopping between rates is killing margins." — Head of Product.
